stage0_add_velocity_units.py.description: TrackMate tracks CSV cleanup + unit conversion: skip non-numeric header/unit rows by coercing numeric cols then dropna on TRACK_MEAN_SPEED & TRACK_DISPLACEMENT; compute speed_factor=0.645/5 um/min per (px/frame); add *_um_per_min columns for TRACK_*_SPEED and MEAN_STRAIGHT_LINE_SPEED; convert TRACK_DISPLACEMENT/TOTAL_DISTANCE_TRAVELED/MAX_DISTANCE_TRAVELED to *_um; save /data/Tracks_with_velocity_um_per_min.csv and /logs/Velocity_Summary.txt (min/median/mean of TRACK_MEAN_SPEED_um_per_min).

stage1_spots_step_velocity_stats.py.description: Stage1 prep/stats: read TrackMate spots CSV (skips 3 header/unit rows by numeric coercion), compute consecutive-frame (Δframe=1) step displacements per TRACK_ID using POSITION_X/Y; convert px→µm (0.645 µm/px) and velocity (µm/min, 5 min/frame). Outputs long-format steps + overall mean velocity column, plus descriptive stats (N, mean, median, SD, min, max) and IQR outlier report (k=1.5, count only; no removal) appended as blocks in /data/Statistics_Results.csv; prints mean and IQR bounds.

stage2_plot_step_velocity_jitter.py.description: Stage2 plotting-only: robustly read STEP_VELOCITY_UM_PER_MIN from data/Statistics_Results.csv (fallback python engine + on_bad_lines=skip), compute overall mean, save mean to figures/step_velocity_mean_used.csv, and generate single-category jitter/strip plot with blue points (#0173B2) + black mean line; outputs figures/step_velocity_jitter.png (300 DPI) and .svg.

history.description: Stage2 plotting-only: reads data/Statistics_Results.csv (handles single-string-column export by splitting on commas), extracts velocity_um_per_min, computes overall mean, makes single-category jitter/strip plot (blue #0173B2 dots, jitter=0.25, size=3.5, alpha=0.75) with black horizontal mean line (lw=2). Saves figures/StepVelocity_Jitter_AllSteps.png (300 DPI) and .svg.

Stage2 plotting fix: robustly read mixed-content Statistics_Results.csv (python engine, on_bad_lines='skip'; if single-column parse then split by comma; keep rows where velocity_um_per_min is numeric). Generate publication strip/jitter plot with single category 'All steps' (blue #0173B2 dots) and black horizontal mean line; save figures/step_velocity_jitter.png (300 DPI) and .svg. No statistical tests.

stage1_spots_step_velocity_stats_clean.p.description: Stage1 stats-only: parse TrackMate spots export w/ 3 header rows (coerce numeric + drop NaNs), compute consecutive-frame (Δframe=1) step distances and velocities using pixel_size_um=0.645, dt=5 min; report IQR outliers (threshold=1.5, no removal); write clean rectangular /data/Statistics_Results.csv (TRACK_ID, FRAME, FRAME_NEXT, STEP_DISTANCE_PX, STEP_VELOCITY_UM_PER_MIN) and separate one-row /data/Statistics_Summary.csv (N steps/tracks, mean/median/SD, IQR bounds/outlier count).

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocities.py.description: Stage2 plotting-only: robustly read data/Statistics_Results.csv (fallback engine='python', on_bad_lines='skip'); aggregate mean STEP_VELOCITY_UM_PER_MIN per FRAME→FRAME_NEXT interval; save figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; plot strip/jitter (one blue dot per interval, x=start frame labeled t→t+1, y=mean step velocity µm/min) with black horizontal line at overall mean across all steps; report IQR outlier count (threshold=1.5, no removal); save figures/interval_mean_step_velocity_jitter.png (300 DPI) + .svg.

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocities_com.description: Stage2 plotting-only: compact single-category jitter plot of per-interval mean velocities from figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv (fallback compute from data/Statistics_Results.csv with on_bad_lines=skip). Blue (#0173B2) points with deterministic jitter; no x ticks/label; no grid; y label 'Velocity (µm/min)'; black mean line = overall mean across ALL steps from Statistics_Results.csv. Reports IQR outlier count (threshold=1.5) for step velocities (no removal). Saves figures/interval_mean_step_velocity_compact_jitter.png (300 DPI) + .svg.

Stage2 plotting-only: read figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv (mean_velocity_um_per_min), plot compact single-axis jitter (blue #0173B2) around central x with black mean line; y-axis starts at 0, major ticks every 1.0 via MultipleLocator; no x ticks/labels; no gridlines; only left/bottom spines; save 300DPI PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_step_velocity_compact_jitter_y0_tick1.(png|svg).

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocities_ali.description: Stage2 plotting-only: read figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; plot aligned (no jitter) vertical blue points at single x; compute overall mean from data/Statistics_Results.csv STEP_VELOCITY_UM_PER_MIN if parseable (engine=python,on_bad_lines=skip) else mean of interval means; draw short black mean segment (±0.12 x) not full width; y starts 0 with 1.0 ticks; no grid; only left/bottom spines; no x ticks/labels; report IQR outliers (threshold=1.5) without removal; save figures/interval_mean_step_velocity_aligned_meansegment.png (300dpi) + .svg.

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocities_com.description: Stage2 plotting-only: reads figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv (mean_velocity_um_per_min) and makes compact single-axis strip/jitter plot (blue #0173B2) with short black overall-mean segment; overall mean from data/Statistics_Results.csv STEP_VELOCITY_UM_PER_MIN (robust read on_bad_lines=skip) else mean of interval means; y-axis starts at 0 with 1.0 major ticks; no grid; left+bottom spines only; no x ticks/labels; reports IQR outlier count (threshold=1.5) without removal; saves 300DPI PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_step_velocity_compact_jitter_meansegment_y0_tick1.(png|svg).

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocities_bee.description: Stage2 plotting-only beeswarm (sns.swarmplot) of per-interval mean velocities from figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; blue points (#0173B2), no x ticks/labels, left+bottom spines only, no grid, y>=0 with 1.0 major ticks; adds short black overall-mean segment spanning swarm width (mean from data/Statistics_Results.csv STEP_VELOCITY_UM_PER_MIN if readable else interval-mean mean). Saves 300dpi PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_step_velocity_beeswarm_meansegment_y0_tick1.(png|svg).

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocity_swarm.description: Fix Stage2 plotting crash: replace invalid ax.tick_params(..., ha='right') with tick_params(rotation=45) + set_horizontalalignment('right') on xticklabels. Reads figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv (interval_label vs mean_velocity_um_per_min), reports IQR outliers (threshold=1.5) and overall mean, plots swarm (blue #0173B2) + black mean line; saves 300dpi PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_velocity_swarm_by_interval.(png|svg).

history.description: Stage2 plotting: reads figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; swarmplot (beeswarm) of mean_velocity_um_per_min vs interval_label (ordered by FRAME if present), blue points (#0173B2) + black overall-mean horizontal line; reports IQR outlier count (threshold=1.5, no removal); saves 300DPI PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_velocity_swarm_by_interval.(png|svg).
history.failure_reason: Matplotlib error: tick_params keyword 'ha' not recognized; caused crash in prior version.

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocity_swarm.description: Stage2 plotting: reads figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv (mean_velocity_um_per_min) and makes compact single-category swarmplot (blue #0173B2) with x-axis ticks/labels removed, y-axis from 0 with 1.0 µm/min major ticks, no grid, left/bottom spines only; draws short black overall-mean segment x∈[-0.08,0.08]; reports IQR outlier count (threshold=1.5, not removed) and overall mean to stdout; saves 300dpi PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_velocity_swarm_compact_y0_tick1_meansegment.(png|svg).

stage2_plot_interval_mean_velocity_beesw.description: Stage2 plotting: narrow (1.45x4.2 in) single-category seaborn.swarmplot (beeswarm) of mean_velocity_um_per_min from figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; blue points (#0173B2), no x ticks/labels, y from 0 with 1.0 major ticks, no grid, left/bottom spines only; draws short black overall-mean segment (±0.12 around x=0); saves 300dpi PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_velocity_beeswarm_narrow_y0_tick1_meansegment.(png|svg).

Stage2 plotting: reads figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; single-category seaborn.swarmplot of mean_velocity_um_per_min (blue #0173B2) with short black overall-mean segment; y-axis starts at 0 with 1.0 tick spacing; no x ticks/labels; left+bottom spines only; no grid; adds explicit left/right padding via xlim(-0.6,0.6) and fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.28,right=0.92); saves 300dpi PNG+SVG to figures/interval_mean_velocity_beeswarm_padded_y0_tick1_meansegment.(png|svg). Reports IQR outlier count (threshold=1.5) without removal.

Stage2 plotting: single-category beeswarm (swarmplot) of interval mean velocities from figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; blue points (#0173B2), y>=0 with 1.0 tick spacing, no x ticks/labels, minimal left/bottom spines, padded margins, short black overall-mean segment; IQR outlier count reported (threshold=1.5, no removal). Y-axis label fontsize set to 28. Saves PNG+SVG (300 DPI) to figures/interval_mean_velocity_beeswarm_padded_ylabel28_y0_tick1_meansegment.(png|svg).

Stage2 plotting: read figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; single-category seaborn.swarmplot of mean_velocity_um_per_min (blue #0173B2) with short black overall-mean segment; y-label fontsize=28; y-lim 0–3 with ticks [0,1,2,3]; y tick labels fontsize=22 with outward left tick marks (length=6,width=1.5); no x ticks/labels; left+bottom spines only; no grid; padded layout; exact PNG size 530x600 px via figsize=(530/300,600/300) at dpi=300; save figures/interval_mean_velocity_beeswarm_padded_ylabel28_yticks_big_dots_ylim3_size530x600.png and .svg.

Stage2 plotting: read figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv (mean_velocity_um_per_min) and regenerate single-category beeswarm (swarmplot) with blue dots size=5, ylabel 'Mean velocity (µm/min)' fontsize=28, ytick label fontsize=16, y-lim 0–3 with ticks [0,1,2,3], outward left ticks, no x ticks/labels, no grid, left+bottom spines only, short black overall-mean segment; padded margins; exact 530x600 px PNG (dpi=300, bbox_inches=None) + SVG saved to figures/interval_mean_velocity_beeswarm_padded_ylabel28_ytickfs16_dotsize5_ylim3_size530x600.(png|svg).

Stage2 plotting: read figures/interval_mean_velocities.csv; single-category swarm(beeswarm) of mean_velocity_um_per_min with blue dots (size=5), no x ticks/labels, left+bottom spines only, no grid; y-lim 0–3 with ticks [0,1,2,3], outward left y tick marks (len=6,width=1.2) and y tick label fontsize=18; ylabel 'Mean velocity (µm/min)' fontsize=22; short black overall-mean segment x∈[-0.08,0.08].
